tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Search homes for sale directly by private owners (no agent, no commission) in Spain (ES) and France (FR). Returns public listing records incl. the mandatory energy rating.

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Full public record of one published listing by id (e.g. EXAMPLE-ES-1 or ES-XXXXXXXX).

tools.name: get_facets
tools.description: Counts of published listings by country, type and city, price range and valid filter values. No arguments.

tools.name: request_viewing
tools.description: Forwards a question or viewing request from a buyer to the owner of a published home. It does NOT book a viewing and creates no offer or contract: the owner replies directly to the buyer's email. Requires the buyer's explicit consent to share their name and email with the owner.
